summary: Warns that enabling both ansible_common_remote_group and world_readable_temp means the world-readable fallback likely never triggers, and access may still fail because group membership isn't verified; Ansible warns in this case.
questions: Why does become still fail with both common_remote_group and world_readable_temp set?

answer_card.title: Combining common_remote_group with world_readable_temp
answer_card.answer_md: If both are enabled, a successful `chgrp` stops further fallbacks, so the world-readable path rarely triggers. Since Ansible doesn't verify the become user is in the group (that would cost another round trip), it may still fail to read the file. Ansible emits a warning in this case.
